narrative:
Your application was denied because the model estimated a 37.0% chance of bad credit—roughly a 37-in-100 likelihood that you would struggle to repay. That is not a certainty, but it was high enough to exceed the bank’s risk limit for approval.

The second most important factor was the type of credit requested. Radio/TV credit is common among approved applicants (35%), so this worked in your favor.
